title: Cabinet Refinishing in Belleview, FL | Painted Cabinets
description: Cabinet refinishing in Belleview, FL for builder-grade and older oak kitchens. Degreased, primed, and coated in durable waterborne urethane enamel.
h1: Cabinet Refinishing in Belleview, FL: New Color, Same Kitchen
heroIntro: Builder-grade cabinets in a newer home or solid oak in an older one can both get a durable painted finish. We handle prep, priming, and enamel so the result lasts.

questions: How long does painted cabinetry last?
Should I refinish or replace my kitchen cabinets?

sections.h2: Two kinds of Belleview kitchens we refinish
body: In Belleview's newer homes, many kitchens came with builder-grade cabinets in a stock wood tone or plain white. The boxes are usually fine, but the color is not what the owner would have chosen, and the factory finish may be wearing at handles and edges. In mid-century homes, it is more often solid wood with an old varnish that has yellowed or worn through.

Cabinet refinishing in Belleview, FL works for both, as long as the boxes are sound. If doors are swollen or the layout needs to change, replacement may make more sense. Our article on refinishing versus replacing cabinets helps you decide.
Paint fails on cabinets when it is applied over grease, slick factory coatings, or dust. Our system addresses each one before any color goes on:
bullets: Degreasing every door, drawer front, and frame
Scuff-sanding to give the primer something to grip
Bonding primer suited to the existing finish
Two coats of waterborne urethane enamel
Hardware reinstalled and doors adjusted when finished

body: Waterborne urethane enamel cures to a hard, smooth finish that resists the knocks, splashes, and cleaning of a working kitchen. It is lower in odor than older oil-based cabinet coatings, which matters when you are living in the house. Color can be matched from a chip, a sample door, or a leftover can, with a full-size drawdown first.
Oak cabinets have deep grain that shows through paint. Some owners like that texture; others want it filled for a smooth look. Our oak cabinet painting guide shows the difference.

sections.h2: What the cabinet estimate spells out
body: Before we start, the written estimate lists every cabinet run, vanity, and built-in included, the primer and enamel by name, the number of coats, whether grain filling is part of the job, and the working schedule. You know in advance which days the kitchen will be partly out of service, and nothing is added later without your written approval. Counters, floors, backsplash, and appliances are masked each day, and the work area is cleaned before the crew leaves so the kitchen stays usable for basics.

sections.h2: Pair it with the rest of the room
body: A new cabinet color often makes the surrounding walls look dated. Many Belleview owners pair cabinets with interior painting in Belleview or start with a color consultation to coordinate counters, floors, and walls. See our main cabinet refinishing service or return to the Belleview location page.

faqs.q: Can you paint thermofoil or laminate cabinets in my Belleview home?
faqs.a: It depends on condition. Peeling or bubbling surfaces usually cannot be painted reliably. We look at the cabinets during the walkthrough and tell you honestly whether refinishing will hold.
Urethane enamel over proper prep is very durable, but any painted surface can chip from a hard knock. We leave labelled touch-up paint for small repairs.

faqs.q: Do you refinish bathroom vanities too?
faqs.a: Yes. Vanities and built-ins can be added to the kitchen estimate and finished in the same system.

faqs.q: How long will my Belleview kitchen be affected?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of doors and drawers, repairs, and whether grain filling is included. The schedule is written into your estimate before work begins.
